judgments.rationale: Before the change, the input emptied after a failed save. At baseline, verification/baseline/runtime-evidence/attempt-07iTr0/native-report.json and attempt-Kg6x1i (both widths) record the input value as "" after an actual offline failure and after an endpoint denial, while the '.r.bad' receipt was showing. The page snapshot in attempt-Kg6x1i/error-context.md shows the error 'Failed to create next action.' and an empty, focused textbox. The baseline before-failure screenshots (images 11 and 12) show the typed draft before submission. After the change, the after-failure screenshots (image 5 at 1280, image 8 at 360) show the exact draft, including its leading spaces, still in the input. The input still has its focus ring, and the existing '× Failed to fetch' receipt sits in the same place. The after-retry screenshots (images 6 and 9) show the action added as the NEXT row with trimmed text, a cleared and still-focused input, and the existing '✓ Added to …' receipt. This is evidence that a user can now retry without retyping. Holdout runs attempt-e6vipg, attempt-ob6X3v and attempt-6fPX5T pass 2/2 each with 0 skipped; this covers the pending state (focused, readOnly, not disabled), single create, and draft retention after denial. The patch adds no visible UI: it adds readOnly={pending}, an awaited submit, and a reordered success/error branch in TodayBoard. Preservation screenshots after the change (images 1–4) match the baseline ones (images 13–16). Header, stax navigation, panel hierarchy, inline 'Failed to fetch' refresh error, Added receipt, command bar and key hints are the same. The existing 360px overflow (about 517px screenshot width) is unchanged and was not made worse. The claim stays within the runtime evidence; no adoption, revenue or broader accessibility claim is made.

risks: The evidence includes no screenshot of the pending or readOnly state. Its UX (no visible busy indicator and no aria-busy) is supported only by holdout assertions, not by visual or screen-reader evidence.
The error copy 'Failed to fetch' is raw, technical wording that existed before this change. It is readable but does not tell the user that their draft was kept or that they can press Enter to retry.
The baseline image set has no gain after-failure screenshot. The empty-input baseline state comes from text assertions and the page snapshot, not from an image.

The after evidence includes no run of the public tests/e2e/journey_today_draft.spec.cjs delivery journey. The private holdout pass does not prove that public file, which the contract says must be run separately.
Keeping the draft across panel unmount, navigation or reload is out of scope. Users may still lose text in those cases.
The pending check covers only a synchronous guard and readOnly. Keyboard and screen-reader announcement of the failure was not tested.
